name: infrastructure-persistence
title: 基础设施层：MongoDB 持久化边界
description: 把 MongoDB 驱动、查询语义、超时、ObjectID、BSON 和错误映射收敛到单一持久化边界。
creator: wanfeng
notes: 2026-09-10: fixed persistence audit findings: transaction fallback only accepts explicit capability errors; outbox has idempotency, lease/reclaim, independent status updates and dead-letter limit; legacy token reissue retires the old document; unique-index preflight fails readiness on historical conflicts. Mongo 7 standalone and Mongo 8 replica-set focused fixtures pass, but AC-P1 and cross-layer/protected-runner/Golden/USN evidence remain partial. branch=base_branch=dev is the repository's documented single-branch workflow, not a self-merge target.
